open_issues: Two items still need supervisor sign-off rather than code (flagged in SQL comments, not silently resolved): (1) the 17 JSON column renames — I renamed the SQL columns and C# properties to match DATA-MODEL.md's no-suffix spelling (cc, words, changes, fields, agenda, totals, overrides, asset_ids, counted, sections, readiness, filters, counts, ours, theirs, items, details) since DATA-MODEL.md is outside my allowed paths and can't be amended from here; a supervisor could instead choose to amend DATA-MODEL.md to the _json spelling. (2) change_log.device semantics — I changed all 44 UPDATE triggers to record the editing device (COALESCE(installation.device_id, NEW.origin_device)) rather than the row's original creating device, per the finding's suggested fix; DATA-MODEL.md §11 doesn't spell this out explicitly so it's worth the supervisor confirming the intended semantics.

audit_log (no change_log trigger/sync columns despite being annotated synced-read-only) and document_pages/document_links (no sync columns, so OCR text and document links don't reach a second PC) are documented with SQL header comments stating the cheapest resolution and flagging them as pending DATA-MODEL clarifications, per the review's own guidance — no schema/trigger changes were made for these since the fix requires a product decision, not just code.

OfficialNumberService's transactional-contract risk (SaveChanges flushing unrelated pending changes; a rolled-back outer transaction leaving the tracked LastSeq out of sync with the DB) is documented in the interface's XML doc as instructed ('at minimum add a comment') but the actual reload-on-rollback mechanics are left to whichever B3 work package builds correspondence approval, since that's where the surrounding transaction is opened.

DbConnectionFactory's key-string heap-residency is documented via XML doc only (Microsoft.Data.Sqlite has no byte-oriented PRAGMA key API to avoid it, as the review itself noted); no functional change was made there beyond the existing immediate command disposal.
notes:
Addressed every high/medium finding, all missing_spec_items, and every low finding (fixing the cheap ones, documenting the two that need a product/supervisor decision). Per finding:

HIGH — SyncedEntity audit columns never maintained: WakeelDb now overrides SaveChanges/SaveChangesAsync (src/Wakeel.Core/Data/WakeelDb.cs) to stamp CreatedAt/UpdatedAt from an injected IClock, set RowVersion=1 on insert (increment on update), and fill OriginDevice from installation.device_id (resolved lazily, cached per context) only when the caller left it empty. WakeelDb now takes IClock in its constructor; DbSession.Open gained an optional IClock parameter (defaults to SystemClock/TimeProvider.System) and threads it through Unlock. New tests: ChangeLogTriggerTests.Insert_ThenUpdate_SetsAuditColumnsAutomatically_AndChangeLogAtMatchesUpdatedAt (uses a new TestClock helper) and Update_ByLocalDevice_ChangeLogRecordsLocalDevice_NotTheOriginatingDevice.

HIGH — cross-year backdating unenforced: OfficialNumberService now checks a global MAX(last_date) watermark across every year for the kind before the per-year row lookup, refusing any date earlier than it. Test: Issue_EarlierDateThanLastIssued_IsRefused_AcrossAYearBoundary_EvenWhenTheEarlierYearHasNoRowYet (issues 2027-03-05 then 2026-11-20, expects throw), matching the exact scenario verified in the review.

MEDIUM — ErrorMapper unreachable SqliteException case: Map now walks the InnerException chain (Unwrap helper) to find the first recognised type before switching, so DbUpdateException-wrapped SqliteException maps correctly. Tests added for single- and double-wrapped cases.

MEDIUM — DateTimeUtcConverter brittle parse: Parse now guards empty/null, strips a trailing 'Z' (preserving the original author's documented anti-Local-Kind-shift insight rather than reintroducing it) and tries 4 formats (7-digit/3-digit/no fraction, space-separated), falling back to the general parser. New DateTimeConverterTests writes raw text via SQL and reads it back through EF for all 4 shapes plus an empty string.

MEDIUM — 44 change_log UPDATE triggers recorded the originating device instead of the editing device: all 44 now use COALESCE((SELECT device_id FROM installation LIMIT 1), NEW.origin_device); INSERT triggers unchanged (creator == origin_device there). Flagged for supervisor sign-off per the open_issues above.

MEDIUM — unfiltered unique indexes vs EF soft-delete filter: added `WHERE deleted_at IS NULL` to ux_assets_inventory_number and ux_financial_cycles_start_date (with SQL comments explaining why, and why ux_correspondence_official_number is deliberately left unfiltered); FinancialCycleService.EnsureCurrentCycleAsync now uses IgnoreDeleted() for its lookup so it can't try to insert over a hidden row. New regression test: EnsureCurrentCycle_AfterSoftDeleteOfCurrentCycle_DoesNotThrow_AndReusesTheHiddenRow.

MEDIUM — 17 _json-suffixed columns vs DATA-MODEL.md: renamed both the SQL columns and the C# entity properties (dropping the Json suffix) across Correspondence.cs, Employees.cs, Assets.cs, Finance.cs, Reports.cs, Meetings.cs, Identity.cs (AuditLogEntry.Details, also updated AuditService.cs), Sync.cs, and 0001_initial.sql — restore_log.details and audit_log.details are now consistent.

MEDIUM — caller-supplied ClockVerdict: OfficialNumberService gained a primary IssueAsync(kind, now, ct) overload that calls IClockCheckService itself and refuses on anything but Ok; the explicit-verdict overload remains for tests/advanced callers. Constructor now takes IClockCheckService. NumberingTests converted to the two-arg overload throughout except two tests that deliberately isolate the explicit-verdict path (verdict refusal, and the cross-year watermark test); added Issue_TwoArgOverload_RunsClockCheckItself_AndRefusesWhenClockIsBad to prove the primary entry point enforces §9 on its own.

LOW fixes applied: SchemaMigrator.Migrate now throws InvalidOperationException when the DB's recorded schema version exceeds the highest embedded script (new tests); GetCurrentVersion is now a pure read (no EnsureVersionsTable side effect, new test). ChangeLogTriggerTests' misleading IgnoreDeleted() call on the non-filtered ChangeLog DbSet was removed. SchemaTests' DbSet-count assertion tightened from >=60 to ==66. Added AuditServiceTests, WakeelPathsTests, ServiceRegistrationTests (AddWakeelCore resolving every registered interface — required adding a PackageReference to the already-pinned Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection package in the test csproj), and SearchFtsTests (insert/update/delete trigger behavior against search_fts). ArabicText.Plural guards int.MinValue (no more Math.Abs overflow) with an XML-doc note on the zero-bucket rendering choice; Normalize gained a remark that it is index-destructive for OCR offset alignment. DbConnectionFactory.ApplyKey gained an XML-doc note on the unavoidable heap-resident key string. audit_log/document_pages/document_links gained SQL header comments documenting the cheapest resolution, flagged pending supervisor sign-off (not silently resolved, since that needs a product decision per the review).
